purpose: Synthetic transition-level adversarial scenarios for a land/resource host that coordinates internal agreements, escrow and property projections with external authorities. This suite is separate from the static TIB-SYNTH-STRUCTURAL-001 fixture manifest.
invariant_set: internal completion is not external registration
no signature or digest alone proves authority competence
external request timeout or ambiguous outcome requires reconciliation before retry
stale, revoked, wrong-jurisdiction or wrong-scope authority must not promote legal status
active challenge, appeal or affected-party conflict must remain visible
surface geometry must not be promoted to a subsurface volume
no benchmark outcome authorizes authoritative mutation in this prototype

scenarios.name: Internal transfer completed without external receipt
required_actions: keep internal workflow status distinct from legal/registered status
obtain competent external process and exact receipt/decision if applicable
do not display internal TitleDeed as national registration
scenarios.rationale: The internal state transition proves only that Mycelix updated its own application ledger.

scenarios.name: Receipt has a valid digest but issuer competence is unverified
required_actions: verify issuer identity and competent authority independently
verify jurisdiction and decision type
verify delegation and valid-time interval
verify revocation/currentness source
scenarios.rationale: A digest establishes byte identity, not issuer competence, jurisdiction or legal effect.

scenarios.name: External register snapshot is stale
required_actions: obtain a current official source snapshot or response
record exact capture time and source version
recheck relevant caveats, filings, appeals and later decisions
scenarios.rationale: A historically valid record cannot establish the current state of the register.

scenarios.name: Authority is revoked or suspended before attempted projection
required_actions: preserve the historical receipt and revocation notice
do not project current legal effect from the receipt
obtain competent legal review of temporal effect and any prior reliance
scenarios.rationale: A prior receipt must not be treated as current authority after suspension or revocation.

scenarios.name: External request times out with unknown outcome
required_actions: query external authority using the original operation/idempotency reference
determine whether the external mutation committed
reconcile receipt and local state
do not submit a new mutation until the original outcome is known
scenarios.rationale: A timeout does not prove failure; blind retry can create duplicate or conflicting external mutations.

scenarios.name: A relevant customary/community challenge is filed after initial review
required_actions: preserve the challenge independently of the receipt basis
identify applicable notice, participation, consent and appeal process
obtain qualified review; do not collapse the challenge into a scalar confidence score
scenarios.rationale: An external receipt and a live challenge can coexist; one does not erase the other.

scenarios.name: Surface parcel geometry is reused for an underground mineral interest
required_actions: require the legally relevant subsurface spatial unit
qualify horizontal and vertical CRS/datum and survey method
report uncertainty and any non-overlap/overlap analysis
scenarios.rationale: A two-dimensional surface parcel is not evidence of the vertical or volumetric extent of a subsurface interest.

scenarios.name: Receipt is authentic but outside the issuer's delegated scope
required_actions: reject the authority reference for this decision type
resolve the competent issuer under the applicable jurisdiction profile
preserve the authentic-but-out-of-scope receipt as evidence, not authority
scenarios.rationale: An authentic issuer can still be incompetent for the requested operation or subject matter.

scenarios.name: A retry is attempted before the prior timed-out external operation is reconciled
required_actions: reject the new retry command
reconcile the original external operation
reuse a stable idempotency/operation identifier only after external semantics are verified
scenarios.rationale: An unreconciled unknown outcome must not create a second write path.

metrics.definition: fraction of held/rejected/unavailable scenarios that produce a new authoritative mutation
fraction of timeout_unknown cases retried before reconciliation
fraction of wrong-scope or wrong-jurisdiction issuers promoted to qualified state
fraction of live challenge/appeal references lost during projection or replay
fraction of stale source snapshots projected as current without a new verification
fraction of subsurface cases accepted without a qualified vertical spatial unit
fraction of frozen sequences producing identical dispositions from identical evidence frontiers

non_claims: All scenarios are synthetic and do not represent a real registry, person, community or property.
This corpus does not determine South African legal status or the correct outcome under any particular statute.
The current Mycelix policy helper is not integrated into Property's live transfer coordinator.
A correct expected disposition is not proof of implementation performance; the corpus must be executed against the actual host integration and independently reviewed.
